description.value: A 67-acre working farm and campground on the Somass River near Port Alberni, with riverside campsites, a petting farm, farm tours, and gentle river trails — a family-friendly rural stop with genuine pastoral character.

address.value: 5955 Hector Rd, Port Alberni, BC, V9Y 9E8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the campground is active (established 1992, 'BOOK NOW' button present) at 5955 Hector Rd, Port Alberni. It describes 67 riverside acres with scenic campsites and two cedar cottages, plus an on-site farm. The website provides phone (250) 723-7948 and email info@arrowvale.ca, neither of which appear in the OSM tags. No specific cyclist amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, charging, tools, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those are left null. The 'BOOK NOW' button confirms reservations are accepted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established campground with campsites and cottages on a scenic riverside property in the Alberni Valley. A clear fit for touring cyclists needing overnight accommodation on Vancouver Island.

peak.label: farm tours and petting farm open
